content: Baileys store shape (behavioral reference, MIT): single generic SignalKeyStore interface get(type, ids)/set(data) keyed by type string union SignalDataTypeMap (pre-key/session/sender-key/identity-key/app-state-sync-key/lid-mapping etc), value = JSON-serialized with BufferJSON. useMultiFileAuthState is the file reference impl; makeCacheableSignalKeyStore wraps with 5-min TTL cache + mutex. Baileys = one coarse type-keyed blob store (contrast with whatsmeow granular interfaces). Creds bundle: noiseKey, signedIdentityKey, signedPreKey, registrationId, advSecretKey, nextPreKeyId/firstUnuploadedPreKeyId, accountSyncCounter, registered flag, pairingCode — gives a checklist of identity/device fields the identity store must eventually carry.
